verdict_note: From reading only: no build, no test, no GUI. Line anchors are at aa4a35e3: harness-core src/motion_commands.rs unless named. Both R60 attempt-3 defects are closed as the lead ruled (option A). property.enable_animation (:874-884) keys sv through current_slot (:2122, slot with no hint), and its row is KEY_AT_CURRENT (action/commands/motion.rs:93), so a caller value is refused parameter_unknown in plan before apply. keyframe.set (:2164) and keyframe.paste (:2482) create a missing anchor or position through key_slot (:1794). That path sets static_implied only where no default exists (:1833, from_keys && default.is_none()), and the static value and keys it writes are the same as at base. Every path that can remove the last key ends in implied_return (:2088): disable (:890), toggle (:907) and delete (:919). It removes the stream only when the flag is set and the keys are empty. keyframe.move, keyframe.shift, shift_selected, ease, toggle_hold, set_interpolation and paste never shrink the key list to zero. Folio validates the flag on every set, read and edit (composition.rs:887-890 through :1047-1051). Undo and redo restore the entry bytes. The three findings are low and do not affect the R60 probes. F1 and F3 are a few lines each in owned files; F2 is a lane-record item. Nothing found blocks judging.

findings.certainty: READ; not run. Module docs at aa4a35e3 compared against the new behaviour.
findings.severity: low (model manual drift: the module docs are the no-context reference for these rows, and they now omit one refusing row and the whole implied-stream contract)
findings.where: src/motion_commands.rs:59-66 (module docs 'Declared limits': only keyframe.add_at_current and keyframe.toggle_at_current 'declare no value ... and refuse a property whose current value composite alone knows'); :2066-2069 (property.read now reports static_implied); :2085-2094 (implied_return)
findings.what: property.enable_animation now has the same contract as the two add-at-current rows: no value (parameter_unknown) and property_default_unknown on an absent anchor or position. The module docs do not name it. The docs also say nothing about the implied-stream rules: keyframe.set and keyframe.paste mark an anchor or position stream they create as static_implied; disable, deleting the last key and toggling the last key off remove that stream; property.read reports static_implied: true. These rules appear only in fn comments and the folio field doc.
findings.scenario: A model that reads the module docs sends property.enable_animation with value, as KEY_AT used to allow, and gets parameter_unknown. Or it reads property.read static_value [37, 11] on an implied anchor and expects disable to return [37, 11]; disable removes the stream instead.
findings.fix: Extend the declared-limits sentence to 'keyframe.add_at_current, keyframe.toggle_at_current and property.enable_animation declare no value ...'. Add one module-doc sentence on static_implied: who sets it, the three paths that remove the stream, and the property.read key.

findings.where: src/motion_commands.rs:2480-2487 (key_slot seeds a missing anchor or position from v = the first pasted key, then compares each pasted key's length with sv.len(), the seeded value's own length); folio composition.rs:984 (validate_keyed refuses static_value of the wrong dimension)
findings.what: When the target anchor or position is absent, its static value is seeded from the pasted key itself. The dimension check therefore compares the pasted keys with themselves and cannot fire. A paste of 1-component keys (rotation, opacity) onto an absent anchor gets past the check and is refused later by Folio: invalid_field at <layer>/streams/anchor/static_value. The same paste onto an anchor that exists is refused paste_property_mismatch.
findings.scenario: keyframe.set rotation [15] at 0; keyframe.copy {property: rotation, times: [0]}; keyframe.paste {property: anchor, time: 0} on a layer without an anchor stream: refused invalid_field (target .../streams/anchor/static_value) instead of paste_property_mismatch.
findings.fix: Before key_slot, for a bare anchor or position address compare v.len() with the StudioLayerProperty dimension (2) and refuse paste_property_mismatch. Alternatively, check the pasted lengths against the property's dimension instead of sv.len().
findings.test: In fix_animation_values.rs: the scenario above refuses paste_property_mismatch with target anchor, and the entries and history are unchanged (the refused() helper).

answers.format_compatibility: Old files: the field is serde default false and skipped when false (folio composition.rs:240-245), so records without it read and re-serialise byte for byte. The tests check that an explicit anchor stream has no static_implied key on the wire and survives a checkpoint reopen. Files from this build read by an older build: StudioPropertyStream has deny_unknown_fields (:234). An older Session::composition_records therefore refuses the whole composition entry with invalid_json studio/composition (session motion.rs:54-55), a typed refusal. The entry bytes stay opaque and are not rewritten, so the flag is not silently dropped. Precedent: corner_pin, masks, three_d, time_remap, frame_blending and effects were all added the same way under CompositionRecordsSchema::V1 without a version bump. Round trip: a bool, written only when true, is exact. A hand-written explicit false reads as unset and re-serialises without the key, the same as keyframes: []. Validation: validate_stream runs for every layer stream in validate_composition_records (:1047-1051). It accepts the flag only on anchor or position with at least one key (:887-890). The validator runs on every set and read (session motion.rs:8-10) and on every motion edit (motion_entries_bytes). The only unvalidated reader is harness-view delivery.rs:505, which renders, and composite never reads the flag. Not bypassable in the paths read.
answers.paths_creating_editing_removing_anchor_o: Create: keyframe.set and keyframe.paste through key_slot set the flag (:1833). property.set_value creates explicit static (flag false, correct: a set value is static, STU-MOT-020b). enable_animation, add_at_current, toggle_at_current, read, delete, move, shift and set_interpolation never create an anchor or position (slot or current_slot without a hint is refused). Edit: set_value with time on a flagged stream inserts or replaces a key and keeps the flag, so a later disable still returns to implied; without time it is refused property_animated_needs_time. keyframe.set or paste onto an existing stream never touches the flag. keyframe.move refuses a collision, so the count is unchanged; shift and shift_selected refuse collisions; ease, toggle_hold and set_interpolation change no count. Remove: disable (:890), delete (:919) and toggle (:907) call implied_return; nothing else can empty a key list. Copy: composition.duplicate_layer clones the composition layer with its flag and keys (:1450-1452), so the copy behaves the same. precompose moves layers unchanged and gives the new outer layer no streams (its anchor and position are implied, correct). remove_layer drops everything. Outside harness-core: no product caller of composite apply_track, camera_layer, target_layer or instantiate_template (git grep: tests only); harness-view builds no StudioPropertyStream. No stale true flag found. A flag can only be true with keys present, Folio refuses otherwise, and every key-emptying path removes the stream.
answers.disable_matches_stu_mot_020b: Yes for anchor and position. A stream the keys created is removed, and the record equals the pre-key record; the test compares the whole composition entry with the record before keyframe.set. An explicit static stream keeps its static value (the opacity and explicit-anchor tests). Other properties are created from their default (scale, rotation, opacity, three_d, mask members, effect params, named values), so a disable leaves a stream whose value equals the absent default; the record differs from before but the value does not. Not fixed and named by the lane: camera and light point_of_interest and text animator params created from the caller's value, and composite track_apply put. Disable on an absent anchor is refused property_default_unknown rather than nothing_to_change, as at base.
answers.enable_matches_stu_mot_038: Yes where the current value is knowable: the first key is the static value (or the default for an absent scale, rotation or opacity) at the given time, so the render is unchanged, pinned at 0, S and 3S. A caller value is refused parameter_unknown before planning (plan checks unknown keys first), and already-animated is refused property_already_animated. Absent anchor or position (and point of interest): refused property_default_unknown, the declared limit (F2). The ported probe r60a3g_enable_animation_keys_the_current_value now passes because the command is refused and its if-branch never runs. The keyed value is covered by the lane's own test.
answers.undo_redo: Exact by construction: commit stores EntryRestore with the previous composition entry bytes (motion_commands.rs:514-525), and history steps restore whole entries. Tests: enable (undo to before, redo to after), disable of an implied anchor (undo to the keyed record, redo to the pre-key record), delete and toggle of the last key (undo only). Each command is one step named by its row (Enable Animation, Disable Animation asserted). Gap: no redo after the last-key delete or toggle. By the byte-restore mechanism it holds anyway.
answers.composite_literals: Behaviour-neutral. All nine edits add static_implied: false to struct literals (camera_solve.rs:608, :609, :643; clip_finishing.rs:988, :1012; temporal/composition.rs:315, :402, :419; motion_records.rs:59; track_apply.rs:204; tests/track_apply.rs:98, :100). Composite never reads the field: temporal::composition::property (:701-728) uses static_value and keyframes only, and git grep finds no other read. The static value and keys harness-core writes are unchanged from base, because key_set still seeds from value and paste from the first placed key.
answers.tests_vs_implementation:
Mostly behaviour. The anchor tests compare the whole composition entry with the pre-key record, read values at several times, and use checkpoint reopen, undo and redo. Representation pins: static_implied true on the created stream; the absent key on explicit streams, which is the byte-identity contract for old files; property.read static_implied; and the Folio refusal Code::InvalidField at .../streams/

/static_implied. All of these are approved-design surfaces, not incidental. Gaps: keyframe.set on an existing explicit anchor keeping its static on disable (only opacity and enable_animation cover explicit streams); flag preservation through set_value with time, keyframe.move and duplicate_layer; redo after a last-key delete; the F3 paste dimension case.
